tests.name: Target Leakage Check
tests.details: Target columns (Attack_label, Attack_type) strictly separated from feature matrix

tests.name: Preprocessing Fit-Transform Leakage Check
tests.details: Scalers and categorical encoders are fitted EXCLUSIVELY on training data

tests.name: Mutual Information Selection Leakage Check
tests.details: Mutual Information computed solely on X_train and y_train; test labels never inspected

tests.name: Train/Test Overlap & Partition Disjointness Check
tests.details: Indices verified: Train ∩ Val = ∅, Train ∩ Test = ∅, Val ∩ Test = ∅

tests.name: Oversampling / SMOTE Leakage Check
tests.details: Cost-sensitive class weighting employed; no synthetic sampling applied before split

tests.name: Scaling Leakage Check
tests.details: StandardScaler computes mean and std on X_train only; test data is strictly transformed

tests.name: Categorical Encoding Leakage Check
tests.details: Unseen categories in test partition mapped defensively to default class index

tests.name: Threshold Optimization Leakage Check
tests.details: Optimal decision threshold optimized exclusively on validation data
